verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents defining dashboards or alert policies as code. NerdGraph is described only as able to "configure some New Relic features", without naming dashboards or alerts. The only Terraform evidence covers Agent Control fleet management, and the CLI evidence covers tags, workloads and deployment markers. All of these are adjacent capabilities, not dashboards-as-code or alerts-as-code provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
